Taxes Committee
Wednesday, April 3rd, 2024
08:30 AM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill
Weber, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Grant Hauschild,
Senator Jeremy R. Miller, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Aric Putnam

Excused: Senator Kari Dziedzic

Senator Ann H. Rest called the meeting to order at 8:31am.
Approval of the minutes from 3/26/24.
The minutes from March 26, 2024, were approved as presented.

S.F. 3475: Senator Kunesh: Columbia Heights refundable tax exemption for construction
materials establishment.

Testifier:
Kevin Hansen, City Manager, Columbia Heights

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3475 be laid over.

S.F. 3470: Senator Kunesh: Spring Lake Park city hall facility construction materials tax
exemption provision and appropriation.

Testifier:
Dan Buchholtz, City Manager, Spring Lake Park

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3470 be laid over.

S.F. 3392: Senator Dahms: Canby Independent School District refundable exemption
provision for construction materials for certain projects.

Testifier:
Chad Anderson, Superintendent, Tracy Public Schools

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3392 be laid over.

S.F. 4978: Senator Draheim: Le Sueur-Henderson School District sales and use tax on
construction materials refundable exemption authorization.

Testifier:
Jim Wagner, Superintendent, Le Sueur-Henderson School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4978 be laid over.

S.F. 4977: Senator Draheim: St. Clair School District refundable exemption for sales and
use taxes on construction materials authorization.

Testifier:
Tim Collins, Superintendent, St. Clair School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4977 be laid over.

S.F. 4350: Senator Green: Cass Lake-Bena Independent School District refundable
exemption provision for construction materials for certain projects.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-1 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment
was adopted.


Testifier:
Sue Chase, Superintendent, Cass Lake-Bena School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4350, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3618: Senator Gruenhagen: Watertown construction materials refundable tax
exemption provision.

Senator Weber moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Michael Walters, Mayor, Watertown

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3618, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3170: Senator Nelson: Rochester exemption provision for construction materials for a
sports and recreation complex.

Senator Nelson moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Shaun Palmer, City Councilmember, Rochester

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3170, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3752: Senator Hauschild: Lake Superior School District construction project sales and
use tax exemption provision and appropriation.

Testifier:
Tanner Spawn, Business Manager, Lake Superior School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3752 be laid over.

S.F. 4868: Senator Hauschild: St. Louis County housing development projects sales and use
tax exemption for certain construction materials.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-5 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-5 amendment
was adopted.

Testifier:
Annie Harala, Commissioner, St. Louis County

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4868, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 1289: Senator Hauschild: Property tax exemption modification for certain airport
property.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment
was adopted.

Testifiers:
Dante Tomassoni, Director of Corporate Affairs, Cirrus Aircraft
Tom Werner, Executive Director, Duluth International Airport

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 1289, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 2365: Senator Hauschild: Graduates of aerospace and aviation-related educational
programs and employers of program graduates income tax credit authorization.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-2 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-2 amendment
was adopted.


Testifiers:

Vance Oakstadd, Director of Talent Acquisition, Cirrus Aircraft

Rachel Johnson, President, Area Partnership for Economic Development
Senator Rest moved that S.F. 2365, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 4918: Senator Putnam: City of St. Cloud refundable sales and use tax exemption for
construction projects in a redevelopment district provision and appropriation.

Senator Putman moved the A-2 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-2 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Dave Kleis, Mayor, St. Cloud

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4918, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 4803: Senator Weber: Various independent school district construction projects sales
and use tax exemption provision and appropriation.

Senator Weber moved the A-5 amendment.
Senator Weber moved an oral amendment to the A-5 amendment: line 1.12: delete "September”
and insert "January" and delete "2025" and insert "2026". The motion prevailed and the A-5

amendment, as amended, was adopted.

Testifier:
Todd Holthaus, Superintendent, Hills-Beaver Creek Schools

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4803, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3228: Senator Mathews: Becker Public School District refundable construction
exemption provision.

Sen. Klein moved an oral amendment: on lines 1.14 and 1.22: delete "2025" and insert "2026"
and on line 1.18: delete "2023" and insert "2024". The motion prevailed and the oral amendment
was adopted.

Testifier:
Jeremy Schmidt, Superintendent, Becker School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3228, as amended, be laid over.
The gavel was transferred to Senator Klein.

S.F. 4591: Senator Port: Construction material used in the city of Burnsville refundable
sales and use tax exemption authorization.

Senator Rest presented the bill for Senator Port.

Senator Rest moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Elizabeth Kautz, Mayor, Burnsville

Senator Klein moved that S.F. 4591, as amended, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 10:54am.

Senator Klein moved the A29 Technical Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A29 Technical
Amendment was adopted.

Senator Klein moved the A32 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A32 Amendment was
adopted.

Senator Klein moved the A35 Amendment. A roll call was requested. Senator Klein moved the A36
Amendment to the A35 Amendment. Senator Klein moved an author's amendment to the A36
Amendment. On line 1.8, strike “an additional”. On line 1.9, insert “a” before “tax”, and after “tax”
strike “of three percent”. Senator Klein requested a roll call, and a roll call was granted. With a vote of

5 ayes, 4 nays, and 1 abstention, the A36 Amendment to the A35 Amendment was adopted.

Senator Klein requested a roll call on the A35 Amendment as amended. With a vote of 4 ayes and 6
nays, the motion did not prevail. The A35 Amendment was not adopted as amended.

Senator Nelson moved the A31 Amendment. Senator Nelson requested a roll call for the A31
Amendment.

Senator Klein moved the A37 Amendment to the A31 Amendment. Senator Klein requested a roll
call, and a roll call was granted. With a call vote of 5 ayes, 4 nays, and 1 abstention, the A37
Amendment to the A31 Amendment was adopted.


Senator Nelson moved that the A31 Amendment be withdrawn as amended by the A37 Amendment.

Senator Hauschild moved the A39 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A39 Amendment was
adopted.

Senator Drazkowski moved the A28 Amendment. Senator Weber requested a roll call, and a roll call
was granted. With a roll call vote of 4 ayes, 6 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A28
Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Weber moved the A12 Amendment. Senator Weber requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted. With a roll call vote of 4 ayes, 5 nays, and 1 abstention, the motion did not prevail, and the
A12 Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Drazkowski moved the A24 Amendment. Senator Drazkowski requested a roll call, and a roll
call was granted. With a roll call vote of 2 ayes and 8 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A24
Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Drazkowski moved the A23 Amendment. Senator Drazkowski requested a roll call, and a roll
call was granted. With a roll call vote of 10 ayes and 0 nays, the motion prevailed, and the A23
Amendment was adopted.

Senator Weber moved the A4 Amendment. Senator Weber requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted. With a roll call vote of 5 ayes and 5 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A4 Amendment
was not adopted.

Senator Nelson moved the A26 Amendment. Senator Nelson requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted. With a roll call vote of 4 ayes and 6 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A26
Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Klein moved that SF 1811 be recommended to pass as amended. Senator Klein requested a
roll call, and a roll call was granted. With a roll call vote of 8 ayes and 2 nays, the motion prevailed.

SF 1811 was recommended to pass as amended.

The meeting was adjourned at 7:46 p.m.
